freeze_scope: These exact 20 public v3 specs. Later edits require a new version and preserve all first attempts.
revision_reason: Final candidate attempt 41968702601 passed the v8 N03 and N15 corrections. Linux then timed out on N04 at the implicit 3-second bound; Windows passed 80 cases in four complete batches before the v3 viewport transform raised KeyError because width and height were omitted and should default to 80x24. All twenty frozen cases now declare a bounded 10-second step timeout, and the batch viewport transform uses public defaults. The v9 attempt remains preserved with zero candidate credit.
